_field_definitions.state_version: Monotonic counter. Writers MUST read, verify matches last-seen, increment on write (compare-and-swap).
_field_definitions.current_round: Round we are currently IN (pending action from round_owner). Polly owns odd (1,3,5), Genie owns even (2,4). Meaningful only while status is ACTIVE.
_field_definitions.last_actor: Who completed the PREVIOUS round: polly | genie
_field_definitions.round_owner: Whose turn it is to act: polly | genie | null. null once status leaves ACTIVE (AGREED/GENIE_FINAL/ABANDONED/OVERRULED) — no further round is pending, so no one 'owns' the next action.
_field_definitions.expires_at: ISO timestamp | null. If round_owner has not acted by this time, status → ABANDONED. null once status leaves ACTIVE — a resolved debate cannot expire.
_field_definitions.implementation_commit: Git commit SHA where agreed change was implemented (null until done)
_field_definitions.implemented_at: ISO timestamp of implementation (null until done)
